after.name: measurement_event_jobs_application_insert
after.withCheck:
((job_type = 'measurement.public-event-received.v1'::text) AND (payload_version = 1) AND (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text) AND ( SELECT (count(*) = 2)
   FROM jsonb_object_keys(jobs.payload) jsonb_object_keys(jsonb_object_keys)) AND (payload ?& ARRAY['eventId'::text, 'portfolioId'::text]) AND ((payload ->> 'portfolioId'::text) = NULLIF(current_setting('shipwithali.portfolio_id'::text, true), ''::text)) AND ((payload ->> 'eventId'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text))

before.name: jobs_check
before.definition: CHECK (status = 'leased'::text AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL OR status = 'available'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL OR status = 'completed'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

after.name: jobs_lifecycle_check
after.definition: CHECK (status = 'leased'::text AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL OR status = 'available'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL OR status = 'completed'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'dead'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL AND last_error_code IS NOT NULL)

after.name: outbox_events_terminal_state_check
after.definition: CHECK ((completed_at IS NULL OR dead_at IS NULL) AND (dead_at IS NULL OR lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL))

after.name: incidents_incident_key_key
after.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX incidents_incident_key_key ON operations.incidents USING btree (incident_key)

after.name: incidents_open_idx
after.definition: CREATE INDEX incidents_open_idx ON operations.incidents USING btree (last_observed_at DESC, incident_id) WHERE (resolved_at IS NULL)

after.name: incidents_pkey
after.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX incidents_pkey ON operations.incidents USING btree (incident_id)

after.name: job_redrive_audit_original_idx
after.definition: CREATE INDEX job_redrive_audit_original_idx ON operations.job_redrive_audit USING btree (original_job_id, created_at)

after.name: job_redrive_audit_original_job_id_key
after.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_redrive_audit_original_job_id_key ON operations.job_redrive_audit USING btree (original_job_id)

after.name: job_redrive_audit_pkey
after.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_redrive_audit_pkey ON operations.job_redrive_audit USING btree (audit_id)

after.name: job_redrive_audit_replacement_job_id_key
after.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX job_redrive_audit_replacement_job_id_key ON operations.job_redrive_audit USING btree (replacement_job_id)

before.name: outbox_events_due_idx
before.definition: CREATE INDEX outbox_events_due_idx ON operations.outbox_events USING btree (available_at, event_id) WHERE (completed_at IS NULL)

after.name: outbox_events_due_idx
after.definition: CREATE INDEX outbox_events_due_idx ON operations.outbox_events USING btree (available_at, event_id) WHERE ((completed_at IS NULL) AND (dead_at IS NULL))
